findings.subject: Availability
findings.result: 20.0.1.123 dated October 13 was the newest in the official Windows change log reviewed on November 14, 2026. The Kamvas 13 Gen 3 catalog offered both compared builds. The original Kamvas 22 catalog offered V15.

findings.subject: Application layout
findings.result: V15 archive has HuionTabletCore.exe and HuionServer.exe. V20 main archive has TabletDriver.exe and TabletServer.exe alongside HuionTablet.exe. One user reported 20.0.1.123 under the administrator's AppData. The separately reported Roaming/HuionTablet absolute-path pattern concerns V20.1.1.90. A default for all 20.0.1.123 installs and the reported all-users switch were not verified.

findings.subject: Virtual HID packages
findings.result: x86 and x64 vmulti.inf, vmulti.sys, huionhid.cat and hidkmdf.sys are byte-identical between these two builds for each architecture. V20 adds hnvmulti.inf and ARM64 helper files.

findings.subject: USB driver package
findings.result: V20 x86 and x64 TabletDriver.inf differ from V15 and list a broader set of literal VID_256C matches instead of the V15 archived PID_XXXX placeholder. The V20 list includes non-hex entries such as PID_006G. Runtime hardware support cannot be derived from this alone.

findings.subject: Windows Ink and WinTab
findings.result: The V20 payload includes DisableWinInk.cfg, WintabMapMode.ini and WintabTerminator binaries. The 20.1.1.106 branch release notes describe per-app Windows Ink. The application of these settings on 20.0.1.123 and whether WinTab is restored on uninstall remain unverified.

findings.subject: Reported problems
findings.result: In the community thread one user reported improvements after moving to V20 without stating the exact build, and a commenter on 20.0.1.123 reported the app landing in the administrator profile. Neither report establishes a general regression. Priority checks are standard-user versus elevated installation, V15-to-V20 migration, and per-app Windows Ink/WinTab with the tablet model and app recorded.

file_metadata_method.scope: Bytes extracted from inspected installers. Installed or leftover file identities were not measured.
file_metadata_method.binary_architecture: PE/COFF Machine field, independent of installer architecture.
file_metadata_method.version_info: Windows file version resources, independent of the installer version and INF DriverVer.
file_metadata_method.signature: Get-AuthenticodeSignature result on the extracted file on the inspection machine. The installer signature is recorded separately. A NotSigned result does not exclude driver catalog coverage.
file_metadata_method.catalog_link: The INF declares catalog filenames. Catalog signature checks are separate from checking file membership in the catalog. Membership was not verified here.
file_metadata_method.payload_file_ids: Links to candidate bytes from the same build. For path or residue claims the links do not establish a match to bytes on disk. Empty means no matched build-specific payload was available from this inspection.
file_metadata_method.embedded_zip_eocd_offset: Byte offset of the embedded ZIP end-of-central-directory signature in the enclosing executable, used where an installer has multiple archives.
